name: Wall Of Fire
rationale: Blaze and Fire Charge trace a Stone-bounded protection seal that Emerald directs into a burning segment.
clues: Outer Plinths hold flame focus, protection seal; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the second outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Flame focus follows blank inscription clockwise.
Firecharge motif follows flame focus clockwise.
Stone motif follows firecharge motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Protection seal follows stone motif clockwise.
Evocation focus follows protection seal clockwise.
Blank inscription follows evocation focus clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
